channel.title: Wahaj Ayub - Research Radar
channel.description: Selected papers in topological photovoltaics, quantum geometry, noncentrosymmetric materials, Hopf phases, and mathematical condensed matter.

item.title: Exploiting Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in a Polar Hybrid Perovskite Towards Self‐Powered Detection of Weak Ultraviolet Polarized Light
item.description: A polar (4-AMP)PbBr4 crystal is used as a self-powered detector whose response is attributed to a strong bulk photovoltaic effect.

item.title: High Order Geometric Channels for Nonlinear Transport in Bloch Bands
item.description: A Bargmann-trace hierarchy extends quantum geometry beyond the quantum metric and isolates a coherent geometric sector of third-order electric-field response.

item.title: Symmetry and Quantum Geometry in Bloch Bands
item.description: Symmetry constrains the real-space embedding that minimizes Berry-curvature variance and integrated quantum-metric trace in tight-binding models.

item.title: Spatially Dispersive Second-Harmonic Generation in Ferroaxial Systems
item.description: A gauge-consistent theory shows that electric-quadrupole and magnetic-dipole channels can both be essential in spatially dispersive SHG from ferroaxial order.

item.title: Symmetry-Based Design Rules for Second-Harmonic Generation in Stacked and Twisted MoS2 Bilayers
item.description: Point-group symmetry maps stacking and twisting in MoS2 bilayers to allowed second-order tensors and a twist-locked SHG polarization pattern.

item.title: On the stable Hopf invariant
item.description: A simplified treatment of the stable Hopf invariant supplies composition and transfer formulas and examines its uniqueness in equivariant settings.
